proof_body:
by
  intro a l h
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, Real.tendsto_tsum_powerSeries_nhdsWithin_lt h⟩
  have h0 : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    have h1 := h.comp (Filter.tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
    have h2 := h1.sub h
    simp only [sub_self] at h2
    refine h2.congr fun n => ?_
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ]
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.1 (Metric.isBounded_range_of_tendsto a h0)
  refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (g := fun n => C * |x| ^ n) ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (abs_nonneg x) hx).mul_left C) fun n => ?_
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs x]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC _ ⟨n, rfl⟩) (by positivity)
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (l : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i) Filter.atTop (nhds l) → (∀ x : ℝ, |x| < 1 → Summable (fun n => a n * x ^ n)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∑' n, a n * x ^ n) (nhdsWithin 1 (Set.Iio 1)) (nhds l)
